criteria.criterion: Counters match what the run persisted (integration test with a stub scraper).
criteria.plannedImplementation: ListingUpserter.Apply returns a per-listing ListingUpsertOutcome (AddedActive, AddedSold, Updated, Skipped); ScrapeStore.UpsertListings aggregates these into a ListingUpsertSummary it returns instead of void. ScrapeRunService.Run builds a RunCompletionCounts from that summary plus result.Listings.Count (TotalListingsFound), result.TotalReportedBySearch, and SearchCompletedUtc/DetailCompletedUtc timestamps captured either side of the item-detail fetch, and passes it to IScrapeStore.CompleteRun, which persists every counter and both timestamps onto ScrapeRunEntity.

criteria.criterion: A run where one item page fails ends CompletedWithErrors with one issue row naming the listing.
criteria.plannedImplementation: A new ScrapeRunIssues table (ScrapeRunId, ListingId, IssueType, ErrorMessage, Phase, HttpStatusCode, CreatedUtc) is written via the new IScrapeRunReportStore.RecordIssue(runId, ScrapeRunIssueDetails, ct). #44 (item-page detail fetch) merged into main during this PR's development, so ItemDetailFetchService.FetchDetails was changed to return IReadOnlyList<ScrapeRunIssueDetails> (previously plain Task) — one entry per listing whose item page could not be fetched or parsed — instead of silently swallowing the failure. ScrapeRunService.Run records every returned issue via IScrapeRunReportStore.RecordIssue and counts issues with a non-null ListingId as ListingsFailed. IScrapeStore.CompleteRun checks db.ScrapeRunIssues for any row for the run and sets the terminal status to CompletedWithErrors (a new ScrapeRunStatus, added as a second legal target from Running alongside Completed/Failed in ScrapeRunStateService) instead of Completed whenever one exists. The same RecordIssue path also carries the pre-existing Mercari band-cap-hit case (SearchPageService.CollectDirection's PriceBandCollectionSummary.CapHit, previously discarded, now surfaced via SearchCollectionResult.Issues).
criteria.plannedVerification: RunPipelineRecordsDetailFetchIssueTests (Integration, real SQLite + real ItemDetailFetchService/ItemDetailStore/EbayItemPageParserService, a stub IScrapeClient that serves the search page but throws for the one listing's item-page URL) runs the full pipeline end to end and asserts the run ends Status=CompletedWithErrors, Issues has exactly one row naming that listing's ListingId with Phase=Detail, and ListingsFailed=1. ScrapeRunReportStoreTests covers RecordIssue and GetRunsForJob directly against real SQLite. ScrapeRunServiceTests.Should_record_a_detail_fetch_issue_and_count_it_as_a_failed_listing proves the wiring at the unit level with a mocked detail-fetch service.

comparisonObservation.firstObservation: A run where the one listing's item page throws on fetch ends CompletedWithErrors with exactly one issue row naming that listing.
comparisonObservation.whenHeldValueAbsent: RunPipelinePersistsListingsTests runs the same shape of pipeline with no item-page failures and ends plain Completed with zero issues — proving the terminal status is driven by issue presence, not a change to the default completion path.

criteria.criterion: Migrating a pre-change database keeps existing runs.
criteria.plannedImplementation: The new migration (20260924005456_AddRunTriggerCountersAndIssues, generated via `dotnet ef migrations add`, ordered after #44's 20260924003128_AddListingDetailFetchAttempts) adds TriggerType (default 'Manual' via HasDefaultValue so existing rows backfill safely) and the new counter/timestamp columns (defaulting to 0/null) plus the ScrapeRunIssues table.
criteria.plannedVerification: MigratingAPreRunTrackingDatabasePreservesExistingRunsTests seeds a database at the prior migration (20260924003128_AddListingDetailFetchAttempts) with a raw-SQL ScrapeRuns row using only the old columns, applies migrations, and asserts the row still exists with TriggerType defaulted to Manual, ListingsAddedActive defaulted to 0, TotalReportedBySearch null, and zero pending migrations remain.

comparisonObservation.firstObservation: A ScrapeRuns row inserted before the migration, with no TriggerType column, is still present after migrating with TriggerType='Manual'.
comparisonObservation.whenHeldValueAbsent: Without the HasDefaultValue configuration, SQLite's ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN NOT NULL without a default fails against a non-empty table, so this default is load-bearing, not decorative.
